[[Cayman Islands Classic]] champions |bowl= [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |bowl_result = Second Round }} {{2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2017–18 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Cincinnati]] in the [[2017–18 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team played its home games at the [[BB&T Arena]] on the campus of [[Northern Kentucky University]] in [[Highland Heights, Kentucky]] due to renovations at their home arena, [[Fifth Third Arena]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.bizjournals.com/cincinnati/news/2017/02/10/uc-picks-temporary-basketball-home-for-fifth-third.html|title=UC picks temporary basketball home for Fifth Third Arena renovation|website=www.bizjournals.com|first=Steve|last=Watkins|access-date=2017-04-26}} The Bearcats were led by 12th-year head coach [[Mick Cronin (basketball)|Mick Cronin]] and are members of the [[American Athletic Conference]]. They finished the season 31–5, 16–2 in [[2017–18 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]] to win the regular season championship. They defeated [[2017–18 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]], [[2017–18 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]], and [[2017–18 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] to win the [[2018 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] and received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2018 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]]. As the No. 2 seed in the South region, they defeated [[2017–18 Georgia State Panthers men's basketball team|Georgia State]] in the First Round before being upset by [[2017–18 Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball team|Nevada]] in the Second Round. In their loss to Nevada, they were up 22 before losing 75–73, tying the second largest comeback in NCAA Tournament history. ==Previous season== The [[2016–17 Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball team|Bearcats]] finished the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2016–17 season]] 30–6, 16–2 to finish in second place in [[2016–17 American Athletic Conference men's basketball season|AAC play]]. They beat [[2016-17 Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball team|Tulsa]]{{Cite news|url=http://www.spokesman.com/stories/2017/mar/10/no-15-cincinnati-eases-past-tulsa-in-aac-quarterfi/|title=No. 15 Cincinnati eases past Tulsa in AAC quarterfinals|work=Spokesman.com|access-date=2017-08-02|language=en}} and [[2016-17 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]]{{Cite news|url=https://www.downthedrive.com/2017/3/11/14896240/bearcats-defeat-connecticut-to-advance-to-aac-championship-game|title=Bearcats defeat Connecticut to advance to AAC Championship Game|work=Down The Drive|access-date=2017-08-02}} in the [[2017 American Athletic Conference men's basketball tournament|AAC tournament]] before losing to [[2016-17 SMU Mustangs men's basketball team|SMU]] in the championship game.{{Cite news|url=http://scout.com/college/cincinnati/Article/Cincinnati-loses-to-SMU-in-the-AAC-title-game-71-56-and-land-six-74919483|title=Cincinnati loses to SMU in the AAC title game, 71–56 and land sixth seed in the South Region|work=InsideTheBearcats.com|access-date=2017-08-02}} The Bearcats received an at-large bid to the [[2017 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 6 seed in the South region. In the NCAA Tournament, they defeated No. 11 [[2016-17 Kansas State Wildcats men's basketball team|Kansas State]] in the First Round 75–61{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=400946448|title=Kansas State vs. Cincinnati – Game Recap – March 17, 2017 – ESPN|website=ESPN.com|access-date=2017-08-02}} before losing to No. 3 [[2016-17 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] 79–67 in the Second Round.{{Cite web|url=http://stats.oregonlive.com/cbk/recap.asp?g=201703190606&home=606&vis=116&final=true|title=UCLA beats Cincinnati 79–67 to earn Sweet 16 trip|last=MARSHALL|first=JOHN|date=March 19, 2017|access-date=August 2, 2017}} == Offseason == === Departing players === {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
